species_absent_from_prior_zone: smoothed with n_records=0, n_effective=0 using same alpha/K formula (never P=0)
neutral_geo_score_rationale: 1/K (uniform prior mass), used when the sample has no coordinates or falls outside the Antioquia grid; documented explicitly, never treated as evidence of incompatibility
zone_assignment_method: row = round(lat/0.25); col = round(lon/0.25); cell_id = f'G025_{row}_{col}'; zone = cell_zone_map_v1.csv[cell_id] if cell_id is in_department else None
coordinates_source: iNaturalist API v1 /observations, geojson.coordinates or location field
elevation_note: The iNaturalist API 'elevation' field was empty/null for all 4466 unique observations queried; no direct elevation metadata was recoverable this way. Elevation-based subgrouping (Fase 6) was therefore NOT executed with observation-level elevation and is reported as unavailable rather than substituted with a DEM lookup (which was out of scope for this protocol and would not be 'elevation_m as provided by iNaturalist').

anti_contamination.interpretation: 27.2% of the observation_ids evaluated (UNKNOWN + KNOWN with obs_id) also appear as source records for prior_zone_taxon_v1.csv. The zone-species prior was therefore partially built from the same individual observations later scored against it. This is a genuine, non-trivial leakage risk and the entire Fase 2-8 evaluation in this run must be read as a GEOGRAPHIC_PRIOR_DIAGNOSTIC, not a clean independent-data validation of the geographic prior's generalization.

baseline_reproduction_caveat.reason: The exact per-sample scoring scripts referenced in validation/fase23a_open_set_automatic/reproducibility/config.json (fase23a_run.py, fase23a_stage2.py, fase23a_stage3.py) were run from a scratchpad in a prior session and are not present in the repository; only summary CSV/JSON outputs remain. This session recomputed centroids and scores independently from clean_known_embeddings.npz and unknown_embeddings.npz using a documented (but not necessarily identical) protocol: KNOWN score = leave-one-out distance to own-species centroid; UNKNOWN score = min distance to full-sample KNOWN centroids. The resulting AUROC (0.6181) does not match the frozen 0.5733 closely enough to be called a reproduction. All weight-sweep and geography-effect numbers in this deliverable are therefore INTERNALLY CONSISTENT (geo vs this session's own visual baseline) but NOT a validated extension of the exact frozen Fase 23A pipeline.
